comment: The tooltip of a working session the Mac cannot watch (spec 2026-11-05-llm-transport-independence §3.5, U6), by agent_watch_issue: the Desktop's SessionStatePresentation.watchIssueHelp and the Go hub's watchHelp, published as the terminal_session slice's `watch_help`, which the phone shows as given. A code this table does not know reads as `unreadable`.

issues.missing: Watchtower can't find this session's log. Watching starts again with the next prompt.
issues.permission: Watchtower isn't allowed to read this session's log. Watching starts again with the next prompt.
issues.compressed: This session's log is compressed, so Watchtower can't read it. Watching starts again with the next prompt.
issues.unreadable: Watchtower can't read this session's log. Watching starts again with the next prompt.
